paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: Comparison between PyramidInfer and full cache baseline with different batch sizes on the LLaMA 2-7B model with input length of 512+256.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between batch size and throughput, measured in tokens per second, for two different methods: PyramidInfer and Full Cache. The x-axis represents batch size, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 60, and tick labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis represents throughput in tokens per second, also on a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 2500, with tick labels at intervals of 500. The plot displays two lines: the pink line, representing PyramidInfer, starts at around 600 tokens per second at a batch size of 4, increases to approximately 2100 tokens per second at a batch size of 32, and further rises to about 2650 tokens per second at a batch size of 64, with a solid line style and no markers visible. The green line, representing Full Cache, begins at roughly 100 tokens per second at a batch size of 4, grows to around 1200 tokens per second at a batch size of 32, and then decreases to about 900 tokens per second at a batch size of 64, also with a solid line style and no visible markers.
